top_signals.title: NYC Rent Freeze May Hit Mortgage Bonds
top_signals.summary: A $506 million bet on thousands of New York rent-stabilized apartments has already soured for bond investors, and Mayor Zohran Mamdani’s rent freeze is threatening to make it worse. (Source: Bloomberg)
